text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The court proceeding against Sonja Nikolovska, owner of the bankrupt financial institution TAT from Bitola, and Julijana Atanasova, former director of the payment operations from Bitola, began on Monday.
- Macedonian companies have the opportunity to use credit line in value of 230 million German marks secured by the government in 1996 and this year.
- The Liberal and Democratic Party have united in Liberal-Democratic party. Petar Gosev, leader of the former Democratic party, was elected president of the newly formed party.

- The Association of the bank depositors in TAT financial institution from Bitola doubts the Macedonian National Bank is hiding probe results to cover up the scandal and threatens to halt the Bitola power plant. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom ++389 91 201 196
